title: Implement Scaled Dot-Product Attention
description: Implement the core attention operation of the Transformer using NumPy, including masking and numerical stability.
hints: Compute scores = Q @ K.T / sqrt(d_k) first and verify the shape is (seq_q, seq_k).
Apply the mask BEFORE softmax by setting masked positions to -inf (or -1e9).
Use the max-subtraction trick inside softmax for numerical stability.
